blocks.text: The Philippine adaptation of the hit Thai horror-comedy film “Pee Mak” surpassed the P100-million mark in ticket sales, 19 days after it premiered in local cinemas. The Wilbert Ross and Bea Binene starrer opened in theaters last Oct. 14 and is now in its fourth week of screening. “We just reached P100 MILLION total gross and counting! Maraming salamat sa mahigpit na yakap niyo sa buong PEE MAK barkada!” Viva Films announced through its social media pages on Sunday, Nov. 1.
